description: GET /v1/merchants/me/balance/charges.csv - saves the charge history of a UTC date range (both days inclusive, at most 366 days, oldest first) as a CSV file in a local directory and returns its path; the file name carries the mode, the period and the chain filter. Test exports cost estimates. A period above 50,000 rows is refused; narrow it. Use paymaster_balance_charges_list to read charges instead of saving them. Requires mode unless exactly one key mode is cached. Uses the cached sk_* key of that mode, else a fresh JWT.

directory.description: Absolute path of an existing local directory to save the file into. An existing file is never overwritten.

name: paymaster_balance_charges_export
title: Save the charge history as a CSV file
